title: Concept: TensorBoard is reachable without authentication
description: TensorBoard is a file browser over a log directory: run names, checkpoint paths, hyper-parameters and text samples of the training set. On a shared training host that is the experiment inventory of the organisation.
applicability: Responses from a training host that serves TensorBoard on a reachable interface.
risk: The caller learns the experiment layout and reads sample training data and metrics.
